# proxmox_ha_resource_migrate (Resource)

Triggers an HA resource migration through `POST /cluster/ha/resources/{sid}/migrate` or `/relocate`. `migrate` moves the resource without the recovery mode; `relocate` uses HA relocation. The response lists blocking and co-migrated resources and is exposed as JSON in `result`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_ha_resource_migrate" "move" {
  sid      = "vm:100"
  action   = "migrate"
  node     = "pve2"
  triggers = { revision = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `sid` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `result` (String)
